mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 66 degrees with mainly clear skies over Fireman's Park and a lovely Full Moon to light up the night.

The city has shared important updates regarding cemetery regulations and public works. Road maintenance is scheduled for Lincoln Street and the Range Trail route between August 4th and 7th. Also, don't forget the city offers rebates for high efficiency toilets and rain barrels to help with property conservation efforts.

There is plenty to do around town. Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area High School hosts a free medical and dental clinic, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree takes place, and the Dane County Farmers' Market is open downtown.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on July 23rd where officers were dispatched to a domestic disturbance in the 400 block of Lucerne Drive.

For your sweet tooth today, Culver's is serving up their Raspberry Cheesecake flavor. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Chocolate Volcano flavor.
